maria (eng-ml): Quick ask — we need a Dedicated capacity plan for onboarding the new 45B chat model. Regions: us-west (H100) + eu-west (A100). Constraints: p99 <= 1200ms, steady RPS ~6k for the model, target concurrency ~4 per GPU. Running quant experiments (q8_0 vs q4f16). Who can run sims and share kernel/region deltas?

josh (eng-platform): I ran a fast sweep this morning. TL;DR: H100+q4f16 gives much better tail than A100+q4f16 at seq=2048. A100 needs ~1.5-1.7x more GPUs to hit p99 target. Full sim file linked below. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

josh (eng-platform): Command I used:
```
./simulate --model 45B --quant q4f16 --seq 2048 --region us-west --gpu h100 --concurrency 4 --rps 6000 --sim-version v0.9
```
Partial outputs: 
- us-west (h100, q4f16): GPUs_needed=42, p50=210ms, p95=480ms, p99=980ms
- eu-west (a100, q4f16): GPUs_needed=68, p50=320ms, p95=760ms, p99=1250ms
- us-west (h100, q8_0): GPUs_needed=50, p99=1150ms (higher tokens/ops tradeoff)
- eu-west (a100, q8_0): GPUs_needed=82, p99=1420ms
Notes: fused-attn-v2 kernel on H100 drops tail by ~15% vs generic matmul path; on A100 the cuBLAS-heavy path is more memory-bound so quant gains smaller. Saved sim: https://internal.redwood/runs/2156789012-45b-sim.json

anita (sre): Good data. Two operational flags: 1) recommend autoscale headroom 25% for us-west, 40% for eu-west given observed surge multipliers (we saw 2.3x peaks last quarter). 2) add pre-warm 13B fallback pool to avoid cold-start penalties if we need to shed load.

sam (eng-ml): Quick quality note from eval: q4f16 at long-context (>1024 tokens) has measurable degradation on long-form coherence. Eval delta vs fp16 baseline on our canonical eval set: ROUGE-L -1.8, BLEU -0.9. q8_0 keeps quality within +/-0.3. Recommendation: use q8_0 as steady baseline, enable q4f16 only for burst/beta fallback where cost/latency wins matter.

josh (eng-platform): Proposed concrete plan: 
- us-west (primary H100 pool): steady config q8_0, target GPUs 50, autoscale buffer 25% (so reserve ~12 GPUs for bursts), fallback q4f16 route for burst with smaller concurrency if quality drop acceptable. Use fused-attn-v2 kernel where available.
- eu-west (primary A100 pool): steady config q8_0, target GPUs 82, autoscale buffer 40% (reserve ~33 GPUs), pre-warm 13B pool sized ~18 GPUs for failover.
Autoscale policy: scale_up_threshold=80% util, scale_down_threshold=35% util, cooldown 120s. Canary/fallback rules: if local capacity < 15% and estimated cross-region latency penalty < 400ms allow fallback to us-west.

josh (eng-platform): Kernel notes: fused-attn-v2 on H100 reduces p99 by ~15% and improves throughput ~12%. On A100 we saw better stability with the matmul+remap path but lower quant benefit; need kernel patch for better q4f16 CUDA path (filed infra ticket #INF-2234).

cluster-bot: Simulation run saved: /runs/2156789012-45b-sim.json :white_check_mark:

anita (sre): Also add circuit breakers: limit cross-region failovers to 5% of RPS to avoid overload. And ensure prefix/KV caching is turned on for the model to shave tail on repeated prompts.

maria (eng-ml): This is great — thanks. Josh/anita, can you update the Dedicated runbook with the numbers + add the sim JSON link + schedule 30m follow-up sync tomorrow? I'll include the eval notes from sam in the quality gating doc.

josh (eng-platform): Will do — putting a PR on runbook now.

sam (eng-ml): I'll produce a short eval artifact comparing q8_0/q4f16 on long-context by EOD.

maria (eng-ml): Perfect. Thanks everyone.
